title: Donut segment labels overflow the right hemisphere instead of truncating

complexity.rationale: The root cause and available-width expression are confirmed; the fix applies the existing left-hemisphere truncation behavior symmetrically to right-hemisphere direct and advanced labels.

summary: S2 Donut direct and advanced labels disable Vega text limits on the right hemisphere. Long labels can paint beyond the chart bounds instead of truncating, causing overflow and apparent chart/container collapse.
symptom: With long segment labels, labels on the right hemisphere extend beyond the available chart width instead of truncating. The overflow can distort or collapse the surrounding dashboard card/chart layout, particularly at responsive sizes.
rootCause: In packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/segmentLabelUtils.ts:320-351, getLimitExpr returns Vega's unlimited value (`0`) whenever a label is on the right hemisphere, even though getWidthExprs already calculates the remaining horizontal reach from the collision-adjusted anchor to the container edge. The rich-label equivalent in getRichSegmentLabelLimitExpr (approximately lines 705-725) follows the same right-unlimited policy. Direct labels anchor right-side text at `width / 2 + collisionHalfWidth` with left alignment (approximately lines 495-523), so text wider than `DONUT_RADIUS - collisionHalfWidth` paints outside the chart. The collision transforms in packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutLabelCollisionUtils.ts:31-94 reserve the ring gap and calculate the anchor position but do not reserve arbitrary text width.

comparison.expected: Both hemispheres constrain direct and advanced label text to the measured horizontal space between the collision-adjusted anchor and the chart edge, truncating when the text is wider.
comparison.actual: Left-hemisphere labels receive a finite Vega `limit` when their measured width exceeds the available reach, while right-hemisphere labels always receive `limit: 0` and can overflow without bounds.

edgeCases.case: Long direct-label name or formatted value on the right hemisphere
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Each text line truncates within the available right-side chart width without changing the donut or container dimensions.

edgeCases.case: Long advanced label with swatch and secondary value row
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The name, primary value, detail value, and total suffix remain within the available right-side chart width.

edgeCases.case: Switching XS-XL responsive tiers with the long-label dataset
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Labels truncate progressively as space decreases; the chart and dashboard card retain stable dimensions.
Existing left-side truncation remains unchanged while the right-side constraint is added.

crossCutting.notes: All interaction flags are false because this is text geometry only. requiresS1S2Parity is false: packages/vega-spec-builder/src/donut/segmentLabelUtils.ts uses the older polar label placement and has no S2 collision-adjusted hemisphere or measured-width limit logic to mirror.

implementationPlan.change: Update the direct and rich SegmentLabel limit expressions to constrain right-hemisphere text using the existing measured max-reach calculation, while preserving unlimited text only when the natural width fits.
Add regression tests asserting finite right-hemisphere limits for direct and advanced label rows, plus unchanged left-hemisphere behavior when text fits or exceeds its available reach.
implementationPlan.lines: existing direct and rich SegmentLabel encoding tests

implementationPlan.change: Use the existing long-label dataset with Direct and Advanced label modes across responsive tiers to verify that the chart and card layout remain stable.
implementationPlan.lines: Donut edge-case dashboard dataset and view controls
